title: FomoGotchi
tagline: Maximize your DeFi rewards across multiple protocols and blockchains. Our tool tracks underperforming assets on protocols like AAVE, Spark, Gearbox covering Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, and Gnosis blockchains.
description: In the dynamic world of DeFi, many investors hold a variety of tokens, including blockchain natives like ETH or MATIC, stablecoins such as USDC or USDT, and other digital assets. The DeFi landscape offers numerous opportunities for liquidity provision, including DEXes, money markets, and yield farming. Staying informed about these opportunities is crucial for optimizing returns, which can reach up to 10% annually. Our project simplifies this process by recommending the most lucrative yield options available in the market, tailored to your portfolio.
how_its_made: As the first step our backend interacts with blockchain nodes to retrieve user token balances. As the second step it aggregates data from blockchain node on average APYs from supported DeFi protocols over the past month. As third step balances and protocol APYs are used to calculate potential annual earnings if tokens are deposited in these protocols. As final step to personalize earning opportunities we considering only tokens in the user's portfolio, ensuring recommendations are relevant and actionable. Experience this with our intuitive demo, which showcases the most profitable yields available in real-time.
